lead: The options include who, whom, whose, which, that, what and where. The word before the blank and the shape of the clause after it decide.
選項有 who、whom、whose、which、that、what、where。空格前面的字和後面子句的形狀決定答案。
steps: Look at the word before the blank: a person, a thing, a place, a time, or nothing.
看空格前面的字：人、事物、地點、時間，或是什麼都沒有。
Look at the clause after the blank. Is a subject missing, an object missing, or does a noun come first?
看空格後面的子句：缺主詞、缺受詞，還是直接接名詞。
Check for a comma or a preposition right before the blank.
檢查空格前面是不是逗號或介系詞。

head: Who or whom
who 與 whom
body: Both refer to people. If a verb follows the blank, the subject is missing: who. If a subject and verb follow, the object is missing: whom.
兩者都指人。空格後面直接接動詞，缺主詞，用 who；後面已有主詞和動詞，缺受詞，用 whom。
ex: Candidates who have management experience are preferred.
有管理經驗的應徵者優先。
The consultant whom we hired last year has left the firm.
我們去年聘請的顧問已經離職了。

head: Whose: possession
whose：所有格
body: Whose works for people and things. It is followed directly by a noun with no article: the client whose order was delayed.
whose 人和事物都可以用，後面直接接沒有冠詞的名詞：the client whose order was delayed。
ex: We contacted the client whose order was delayed.
我們聯絡了訂單延誤的那位客戶。
The firm whose bid was lowest won the contract.
出價最低的那家公司拿下了合約。

head: Which or that
which 與 that
body: Both refer to things. After a comma, only which is correct. That belongs to the defining clause, with no comma and no preposition before it.
兩者都指事物。逗號後面只能用 which。that 用在限定用法，前面沒有逗號，也沒有介系詞。
ex: The software, which was released in May, has received positive reviews.
這款五月推出的軟體獲得了好評。
The report that you requested is attached.
你要求的報告在附件裡。

head: Preposition + which or whom
介系詞 + which / whom
body: A preposition can come before the pronoun: in which, to whom. After a comma, a quantity can come first: both of which, most of whom. That never follows a preposition.
介系詞可以放在關係代名詞前：in which、to whom。逗號後可以先放數量：both of which、most of whom。that 不能放在介系詞後面。
ex: This is the building in which the conference will be held.
研討會將在這棟大樓舉行。
Please send the invoice to the person to whom you spoke yesterday.
請把發票寄給你昨天通話的那位。
We received two proposals, both of which are affordable.
我們收到兩份提案，兩份的價格都負擔得起。

head: What, whoever, those who
what、whoever、those who 的用法
body: What means the thing that and has no word before it. Whoever means anyone who. Those who means the people who and takes a plural verb.
what 等於 the thing that，前面沒有先行詞。whoever 是「任何……的人」。those who 是「那些……的人」，用複數動詞。
ex: What impressed the judges most was the design.
最讓評審印象深刻的是設計。
Whoever completes the survey first will receive a gift card.
最先完成問卷的人可以獲得一張禮物卡。
Those who wish to attend must register by Friday.
想參加的人必須在星期五前報名。

head: Where and when: a complete clause
where、when：後接完整子句
body: Where (place) and when (time) are followed by a complete clause. Which, who and whom are followed by a clause with something missing.
where（地點）、when（時間）後面是完整子句。which、who、whom 後面的子句會缺主詞或受詞。
ex: The factory where the parts are made is in Poland.
生產這些零件的工廠在波蘭。
The city which we visited in May was very quiet.
我們五月造訪的那座城市非常安靜。

pairs.right: The software, which was released in May, is popular.
pairs.wrong: The software, that was released in May, is popular.

pairs.right: This is the room in which the interview will take place.
pairs.wrong: This is the room in that the interview will take place.
why: That cannot follow a preposition. Use which or whom.
介系詞後面不能用 that，要用 which 或 whom。

pairs.right: We called the client whose order was late.
pairs.wrong: We called the client who order was late.
why: A noun, order, follows the blank directly, so the word must show possession: whose.
空格後面直接接名詞 order，要用表示所有格的 whose。

traps: A short phrase such as we think or it believes can sit inside the clause. Cross it out, then check what is missing after the blank.
子句中間可能插入 we think、it believes 這類短語。先劃掉它，再看空格後面缺什麼。
In a defining clause, a pronoun that is the object can be left out: the report you requested. It cannot be left out when it is the subject or follows a comma.
限定用法裡，當受詞的關係代名詞可以省略：the report you requested。當主詞或前面有逗號時不能省略。
A sentence about people does not always need who. If a noun follows the blank, as in the client whose order, the answer is whose.
句子在講人，不代表一定用 who。空格後面接名詞時，例如 the client whose order，答案是 whose。
